b07_auroc_reproducibility_note: b07_test_auroc_this_run is the AUROC obtained by re-running B07 in this script; b07_test_auroc_reference is the historical Wave 1 value. Both are reported for transparency; small floating differences (if any) reflect no code changes, only re-execution.
methodology: For each feature, delta = |feature(variant) - feature(base)| is computed per pair. pseudo_similarity = 1/(1+delta) (monotonic decreasing in delta) is fed through the SAME compute_auroc() used throughout the project. This mirrors the single-dimension methodology of Wave 8's feature ablation (experiments/v2/run_feature_ablation_wave8.py) for direct comparability. No feature was chosen or discarded based on its resulting AUROC — the full list was fixed by the Phase 4 spec before this script was written.

features_unavailable.memory: No memory instrumentation exists anywhere in the tracing stack. sbg/extraction/dynamic/tracer.py and sbg/v2/execution/runner.py import no resource/psutil/tracemalloc module and record no memory metric of any kind. Fabricating a memory feature would violate the no-fabrication mandate; this feature is honestly reported as UNAVAILABLE rather than approximated.
features_unavailable.cpu: Only wall-clock time (time.monotonic_ns) is measured by SandboxRunner (sbg/v2/execution/runner.py L145-151) and the v1 Tracer (sbg/extraction/dynamic/tracer.py L174, L187-188). No CPU-time measurement (time.process_time / resource.getrusage) exists. Reported as UNAVAILABLE rather than substituting wall-time under a different label.

features_strongly_correlated_with_b07_sc.note: Pearson correlation between each feature's per-pair delta and B07's own similarity score, across all valid pairs. A strong correlation here would indicate B07's score is largely REDUNDANT with a superficial feature (a stronger form of shortcut exploitation than label-correlation alone), independent of whether that feature predicts the label well.

critical_nuance_constituent_vs_independe: Of the 4 flagged features, 3 (call_count_total, n_functions_called, exception_fraction) are NOT independent confounds discovered post-hoc - they are near-direct constituent measurements already fused INSIDE B07's own DynamicGenome distance formula (sbg/v2/execution/genome.py::distance): n_functions_called overlaps with the coverage/call-frequency signal (d_coverage + d_call_freq, weight 0.60 combined), exception_fraction IS exception_rate (part of d_exception, weight 0.15), and call_count_total overlaps with the same call-frequency signal. Their high AUROC and strong negative correlation with B07's score (-0.37 to -0.80) is therefore expected and definitional, not evidence of an UNDISCLOSED shortcut riding along with B07 - it is evidence that B07's own features ARE these superficial execution-volume statistics, just re-weighted. The ONE feature that is a genuinely INDEPENDENT, not-fused-into-B07 superficial property is wall_time_ms (AUROC=0.5706, matches/beats B07, moderate correlation -0.37 with B07 score, NOT any input to DynamicGenome or its distance function). This is the more scientifically important finding: B07's discrimination is not obviously separable from raw execution-volume/exception-occurrence statistics, and a model with direct access to wall-clock time alone performs comparably. Both framings are reported; neither is hidden.
verdict_note: The following superficial feature(s) predict the CHANGED/EQUIVALENT label at least as well as B07 Dynamic V2 (AUROC>=0.5292): ['wall_time_ms', 'call_count_total', 'n_functions_called', 'exception_fraction']. This is disclosed per the Phase 4 mandate ('If a trivial feature predicts labels as well as B07: DOCUMENT IT.').
branch_coverage_proxy_disclosure: 'coverage_size_proxy_for_branches' is NOT a genuine executed-branch count. sbg/extraction/dynamic/tracer.py records LINE coverage via sys.settrace line events (state.coverage.add(frame.f_lineno)), not branch-taken/not-taken pairs. It is used here as the closest available proxy and is explicitly labeled as a proxy, not fabricated as a true branch-coverage metric.
integrity_notes: Frozen benchmark/datasets/pairs_test.jsonl was used unmodified (744 pairs, same file as H7-H10/Wave2).
No feature was added, removed, or re-weighted after seeing its AUROC. The full feature list was fixed by the Phase 4 spec text before implementation.
memory and CPU are reported UNAVAILABLE with an explicit code-level reason, not imputed or approximated under a misleading label.
